title: HuGE Calculator webinar video and slides available
summary: Watch the video or download the slides from our March 11, 2021 webinar featuring the HuGE Calculator.
bodyHtml: In our March 11, 2021 webinar, Jason Flannick and Peter Dornbos discussed their work on the Human Genetic Evidence (HuGE) Calculator, an in-development tool for quantifying genetic evidence that supports the role of a gene in a disease or trait of interest. The video is available on our YouTube channel and is also linked from the CMDKP Resources page. Download the slide deck here.
